title: The Wardrobe of the fourth floor walk-up
author: P. M. Delacroix
blurb: Oscar Joubert, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
